description: RELICTRA is a team of passionate innovators exploring the forgotten history of human space exploration. Through research, creativity, and technology, we aim to uncover the stories behind NASA's abandoned equipment on the Moon and Mars. We believe every forgotten object holds a story worth preserving. We welcome members interested in space science, coding, web development, research, storytelling, UI/UX design, and creative thinking. Together, we bring forgotten missions back to life!
